route_decision.reason: The retained qBC histogram multiplicity can be factored exactly by t. The union t-set consumer assigns every qBC-bin H tuple the union of all admissible t windows and is therefore a same-population overcount whenever multiple t values occur. Future bounded replay should consume exact t multiplicities directly and retain the union column only as an audit upper bound.
route_decision.next_gate: build the exact multiplicity-correlated Picard consumer, enforce every qBC-bin marginal identity against the retained source histogram, and execute only under a fresh bounded-panel authorization
